title: import_sample input
description: Imports one kick that generate_kick produced in this session into an empty clip slot of an existing audio track in the open Live set (Session view). The file is named only by its sample_id; there is no path argument. The user must confirm before anything is sent to Live. Refused without any change in Live: an unknown sample_id, a track index that does not exist or is not an audio track, a slot that does not exist or already holds a clip.

sample_id.description: The sample_id that generate_kick returned for this kick in this session. Copy it exactly; it is not a file name or a path.

track_index.description: 0-based index of an existing audio track, as list_tracks returned it. A MIDI track is refused.

slot_index.description: 0-based clip slot (scene) on that track. Leave it out to use the first empty slot. An occupied slot is refused, never overwritten.
